answer_1.quote: We examine whether the dataset STORYANALOGY can enhance the ability of analogy generation.

answer_4.quote: A crowd annotation is conducted to evaluate the quality of the generated stories from the models mentioned above. Workers are provided with a source story and its corresponding generated target story. They are then asked to assess the following: (1) Whether the target story is considered an analogy to the source; (2) Novelty of the target story; (3) Plausibility of the generations.
answer_4.guideline: Workers assess analogy, novelty, and plausibility of generated stories.
